verdict.rationale: Event replay and backfill are a fair axis for a customer data pipeline like RudderStack, but the evidence pack never documents archiving events or replaying them into a new or repaired destination. Reverse ETL warehouse syncs and redeploying older transformation versions are adjacent features, not event replay or historical backfill, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks
